email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 22-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGluca (dose: 25mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-04-03.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter664@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
